sources_used: venue websites linked from ZIv / shard fields

findings.name: Inca Lanes
findings.evidence_quote: No DDR, just Guitar Hero. Games: Guitar Hero Arcade.
findings.note: Bowling alley. ZIv explicitly rules out DDR; only GH listed. Entry last updated 2020; current floor not reconfirmed.

findings.name: It's Game Time At The Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling alley with a large redemption style arcade... Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Updated 2026-04-02.
findings.note: Redemption-heavy FEC. ZIv picture titled Supernova is historical only; current games list has GH only, no DDR/PIU/SMX.

findings.name: Joe's Playland
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Perfect). Updated 2026-05-23. Seasonal Salisbury Beach arcade, two buildings.
findings.note: Large retro/pinball/redemption floor. Only music title on ZIv is Guitar Hero Arcade (maps to other).

findings.name: John's Incredible Pizza Co.
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Location: Right of DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME). Information also mentions DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME. Updated 2021-09-03.
findings.note: Modesto CA. GH confirmed on ZIv games table. DDR Extreme appears only in stale info/location text and is NOT in the games table; do not claim ddr without a fresher visit. No recent independent confirm.

findings.name: John's Incredible Pizza Co.
findings.evidence_quote: Verified DDR and Percussion both long gone. Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade only.
findings.note: Roseville CA. Jammer Jones 2025-12-20: former SuperNOVA and Percussion Master removed; only GH remains.

findings.name: Joystiq
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade; ITGmania (Updated to ITGMania 0.7.0 and using Simply Love... Currently maintained by Volactix). Updated 2026-06-13.
findings.note: Merced barcade. ITGmania dedicab + GH only for music; no Konami/Andamiro PIU/DDR/SMX listed. Map reviews call the pad machine DDR generically. both map to other in pipeline.

findings.name: Jumpers At Tinsletown
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Updated 2016-02-24. Cinemark Tinseltown Houston 290 still operates as a theater.
findings.note: No post-2016 confirmation that the Jumpers lobby arcade still exists or still has GH. Theater brand lives on; arcade room status unclear.

findings.name: Kennywood Penny Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Currently out of order as of July 2025). Updated 2025-09-06. Park admission required.
findings.note: Amusement-park arcade. Only music title is GH (listed OOO mid-2025). No DDR/PIU/SMX.

findings.name: KingCade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Free Play). Comment: There is DDR Ultramix 2 on XBOX with one TX-1000 pad hooked up to the console.
findings.note: Overland Park freeplay retro arcade still advertised open (kingcade-kc.com). Console Ultramix+pad is not an arcade DDR cab; do not map to ddr. Only arcade music title is GH.

findings.name: Knuckleheads
findings.evidence_quote: WARNING! - DDR is bootleg! Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Location: Next to DDR). Updated 2014-03-14.
findings.note: Lake Delton WI family fun center. Bootleg pad game mentioned but not listed as a ZIv machine row; only GH is listed. Stale 2014; current floor unconfirmed.

findings.name: Kugelhalle Arcade (Busch Gardens Williamsburg)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (14 credits / 1 song). One of three arcades inside Busch Gardens Williamsburg. Updated 2024-12-10.
findings.note: Theme-park Germany section. GH only for music; no classified BEMANI/PIU/SMX.

findings.name: La Habra 300 Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade... appeared to replace an old ITG3 cabinet around Holiday 2017. Updated 2021-10-23.
findings.note: Bowling alley. Former ITG gone; only GH listed. 2021 ZIv; not rechecked on site.

findings.name: Laser Fun Zone
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade ($.50 per song per player). Updated 2022-04-19.
findings.note: Lacey WA laser tag/arcade. GH only on ZIv; no newer evidence of classified rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Leo's Place Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Mostly redemption games, but also has In The Groove 2 somehow. Only ITG machine in the area - had a DDR EXTREME at some point, but not anymore. Music Game: In the Groove 2 (OpenITG).
findings.note: Idaho Falls. ITG2/OpenITG maps to other; DDR Extreme explicitly gone. 2023 ZIv last pass.

findings.name: Lost Levels Video Game Store + Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Free Play). GAME LIST links to lostlevelsarcade.com. Updated 2025-11-17.
findings.note: Claremont Packing House freeplay retro arcade. Official site game list is classic/pinball; ZIv music section is GH only. No PIU/DDR/SMX on ZIv or site list.

findings.name: Lucky Strike (Rocklin)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet (DDR SuperNova cabinet, currently running Inorizushi's DDR Extreme JP theme). Comment 4 years ago: used to have StepManiax... now only have a DDR SuperNova machine that's modded with a StepMania-based install. Updated 2026-04-04.
findings.note: NOT StepManiaX product (slug stepmaniax). Converted SuperNOVA running StepMania/DDR Extreme theme maps to other. Historical ZIv photos of PIU/SMX/Groove Coaster/Neon FM/DDR are obsolete.

findings.name: Main Event (Frisco)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Comments: rest in peace main event frisco pump it up (SideOfFries, ~6 months before page capture). Updated 2026-03-13.
findings.note: Former Pump It Up cab removed per player comment; current ZIv music list is GH only. Corporate marketing names DDR generically for the chain; do not attach Frisco.

findings.name: Main Event (Grand Prairie)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Beat Saber Arcade (US$4.00 for 1 song). Updated 2026-03-13.
findings.note: Beat Saber Arcade maps to other (USA_EXTRA_SERIES). No DDR/PIU/SMX on ZIv.

findings.name: Main Event (Jacksonville)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Beat Saber Arcade (Great). Updated 2026-05-01.
findings.note: Beat Saber only music title on ZIv; rest is Mario Kart / shooters / sports.

findings.name: Main Event (Lewisville)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Location: In the corner to the right of the ramp). Updated 2026-03-13.
findings.note: GH only music cab on ZIv.

findings.name: Main Event (Webster)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Old comment mentions Extreme/SuperNOVA pads (11 years ago); those cabs not on current games list. Updated 2026-03-13.
findings.note: Historical DDR Extreme/SuperNOVA gone from listing; only GH remains as music game.

findings.name: Marquee Pinball Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Marquee Pinball's second location... Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Updated 2026-08-02 (2 days before research).
findings.note: Napa CA. Fresh ZIv: only music title is GH among video/pinball mix.

findings.name: McDonalds
findings.evidence_quote: Restaurant game room. Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Right guitar broken... Bad). Updated 2025-07-26.
findings.note: Wisconsin Dells McDonald's game room. GH only music title; condition poor.

findings.name: Mining Town Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade; Neon FM. Comment: DDR Extreme cab is gone. Updated 2026-07-25.
findings.note: Six Flags Magic Mountain park arcade. GH + Neon FM both map to other. No classified rhythm series.

findings.name: Mission Control
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Great). Updated 2026-03-30. McFadden Market Santa Ana.
findings.note: Retro barcade mix; only music title GH.

findings.name: Moonwalker Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (Currently unplugged and moved to the back corner / Not Working). Updated 2026-02-23.
findings.note: Johnson City NY mall arcade opposite Dave & Buster's. GH still on inventory but unplugged as of Feb 2026.

findings.name: Movies 12 @ Gateway Mall
findings.evidence_quote: Cinemark Movies 12... Closed. Opened in the Gateway Mall... It was closed in September 2014.
findings.note: Springfield OR Cinemark Movies 12 closed 2014; ZIv still listed OpenITG StepMania convert last updated 2014-02. Yelp also marks closed. Not the later Cinemark 17 at Gateway.

findings.name: Mr. Gatti's Pizza (Amarillo)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Comment 2024-05-01: Game list hasn't been updated in over a decade. Old comment mentions Extreme.
findings.note: Pizza parlor. Current listed music game is GH only; DDR Extreme reference is ancient and not on current table.

findings.name: Mr.Zeros Quarter Cafe Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (US$0.75, Perfect). Updated 2023-03-05.
findings.note: Oxford MI pinball/arcade cafe. GH only music title; no newer recheck.

findings.name: Muvico Starlight 20
findings.evidence_quote: Carmike acquired Muvico... became the AMC Highwoods 20 in January 2017. ZIv still lists Guitar Hero Arcade only (updated 2015-05-04).
findings.note: Theater rebranded to AMC Highwoods 20 and still shows movies. No evidence the lobby GH arcade still exists; 2015 ZIv only. Do not treat as closed theater.

findings.name: My House
findings.evidence_quote: DDR Machine modded to in the groove. has over 4000 songs. want to come play text me or call at 706-263-4782. Private home Calhoun GA. Updated 2014-03-28.
findings.note: Private home ITG listing from 2014. No public confirmation it still exists or is available; do not claim has_games without contact proof.

findings.name: Nickelodeon Universe (Mall of America)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Comments note historical SuperNOVA/3rd Mix/Taiko are gone. Updated 2024-12-16.
findings.note: Small Xscape-style arcade inside NU. Only current music title GH; old DDR/taiko comments are 14 years old.

findings.name: Nickelrama
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (US$0.30). Updated 2016-12-16. Venue still operating per nickelrama.com (Belt Line location).
findings.note: Garland TX nickel arcade still open (2 locations). ZIv music list is 2016 GH only; no modern DDR/PIU/SMX evidence found.

findings.name: Nugget Skywalk Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Pictures include historical DDR SOLO. Updated 2021-12-18.
findings.note: Nugget Casino Resort Sparks. Current listed music cab is GH; DDR Solo photo is not a current games-row entry.

findings.name: Oh Wow! Nickel Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: In the Groove 2 (still running ITG2 r23; pads in bad shape). If you want Simply Love go to Joystiq. Updated 2025-08-30.
findings.note: Merced. ITG2 dedicab maps to other. No other music titles. Location notes reference old DDR 4thMIX Solo as landmark only, not present on games list.

findings.name: Old North Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: They removed every music game but guitar hero. RIP Old North. Goodbye rhythm games. Chunithm is at the hitmitsu arcade right now. Current Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade only. Updated 2025-04-10.
findings.note: Columbus OH barcade. Multiple player comments confirm CHUNITHM and other rhythm cabs removed ~2025; only GH remains. Do not reattach chunithm here.

findings.name: Omni's House
findings.evidence_quote: Private cab ITG2 dedicab in home. Marker is slightly off for privacy. Updated 2015-03-15.
findings.note: Private Avondale Estates GA home cab from 2015. No public proof it is still hosted; leave unknown.

findings.name: Outer Limits Fun Zone
findings.evidence_quote: Mainly a ticket (redemption) arcade. Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Updated 2023-04-09.
findings.note: Pocatello FEC. GH only music title; Spider Stompin' joke note is not a dance game.

findings.name: Park Lanes
findings.evidence_quote: The Arcade is mostly a ticket redemption place. Extreme machine is gone, and replaced with a number of new games. Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Updated 2018-08-20.
findings.note: Hillsboro OR bowling. DDR Extreme explicitly removed by 2018; only GH remains on list. Floor not rechecked since 2018.
